PC-88VA guest drivers bundled with vaeg
========================================

HOSTFAT.SYS
-----------

HOSTFAT.SYS is vaeg's read-only PC-Engine host-folder block driver. Put the
driver on a PC-Engine boot disk and add this line to CONFIG.SYS:

    DEVICE=HOSTFAT.SYS

Start vaeg with `--hostfat-dir` or enable the HOSTFAT read-only host folder in
the GUI. Keep the driver from the same vaeg distribution as the executable.

SQEMM98.SYS
-----------

SQEMM98.SYS is the PC-88VA port of SQEMM98 MAX for vaeg's EMS board. It is the
EMS manager, not the complete EMMVA/RDEMS stack. When using EMMVA 1.5a and
RDEMS 1.52, CONFIG.SYS must load the drivers in this order:

    DEVICE=EMMVA01.SYS
    DEVICE=SQEMM98.SYS
    DEVICE=EMMVA02.SYS
    DEVICE=RDEMS.SYS -P40 -A

Enable a 1 through 13MB EMS Board capacity in vaeg before booting that disk.
SQEMM98 messages use the PC-Engine Text BIOS.

Licenses and integrity
----------------------

`licenses/HOSTFAT.txt` contains the HOSTFAT license.
`licenses/SQEMM98.txt` contains the SQEMM upstream license and the PC-88VA
port license. `SHA256SUMS` covers both drivers, this README, and both license
files.
